questions.stem_text: Why is the organism that causes smallpox not used in the vaccine against smallpox?

options.A: The organism is extinct in the wild and cannot be harvested for vaccine production
options.B: The organism that causes smallpox is too costly to use in vaccine production
options.C: The use of the actual virulent variola virus may be dangerous if too much is administered
options.D: Smallpox virus is confined to research laboratories
options.E: There is no specific treatment for smallpox

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - The use of the actual virulent variola virus may be dangerous if too much is administered

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is not a form of interspecies interaction?
How does the body control the amount of water excreted?

options.A: The body controls water excretion through sweat glands.
options.B: Water excretion is determined by the concentration of electrolytes in the body's cells.
options.C: The kidneys control water excretion by changing the size of the glomerulus.
options.D: Water excreted is controlled by the hormone insulin.
options.E: The body adjusts water excretion by altering the pH level of the blood.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The body controls water excretion through sweat glands.

questions.stem_text:
What problems are posed in referring to the many forms of protozoans as belonging to one
single animal phylum?

options.A: Consistent response to antibiotics across all protozoan forms
options.B: Inability to adapt to environmental conditions
options.D: Extreme diversity, taxonomic organization, possession of certain plant-like features
options.E: Indistinct cellular structures among different protozoan groups

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Extreme diversity, taxonomic organization, possession of certain plant-like features
